seoTitle: The Vampire Diaries Test: Which Character Are You? (12 Questions)
metaDescription: Take The Vampire Diaries test: 12 everyday questions reveal whether you're Elena, Stefan, Damon, Caroline, Bonnie, Katherine, Matt or Alaric. Get your full character breakdown.
intro: Are you the one who writes everything down, the one who organises everything, or the one who shows up uninvited with a bottle of bourbon? Answer 12 everyday questions about love, loyalty and bad decisions, and find out which Vampire Diaries character you are.

characters.name: Elena Gilbert
characters.title: The Heart of Mystic Falls
characters.summary: Compassionate, brave and always putting others first. You feel everything deeply, and you'd do anything to protect the people you love.
description: Like Elena, you've been through more than your share. Her parents died when their car went off Wickery Bridge, and she was the only one pulled out alive.
You process life by writing it down. Elena pours everything into her diary, from grief to first love.
You'd sacrifice yourself for the people you love. Elena was ready to give her life again and again to protect her family and friends, and she found herself torn between two brothers.
characters.flaw: You try so hard to save everyone that you forget to save yourself.
characters.signature: A leather diary, a long look out of the window and two brothers who'd do anything for her.
characters.clashReason: they'd always put everyone else first, even when it hurts them

characters.name: Stefan Salvatore
characters.title: The Noble Brother
characters.summary: Kind, thoughtful and self-sacrificing, with a dark side you work very hard to control.
description: Like Stefan, you're the good one, most of the time. He's a vampire, more than 160 years old, who chose to live on animal blood so he wouldn't hurt people.
You keep a tight grip on yourself for a reason. When Stefan lost control he became "the Ripper", and he's spent a lifetime carrying the guilt.
You'd give anything for the people you love. Stefan mentored Caroline through her new life as a vampire, and in the end he sacrificed himself to save the town.
characters.flaw: You carry guilt for so long it becomes part of who you are.
characters.signature: A leather jacket, an old journal and a very serious expression.

characters.name: Damon Salvatore
characters.title: The Bad Boy
characters.summary: Sarcastic, impulsive and dangerously charming. You act like you don't care, but you'd burn the world down for the right person.
description: Like Damon, you've got a smart mouth and a bad reputation. He arrived in Mystic Falls as the charming, cruel Salvatore brother who did whatever he wanted.
You act first and think later. Damon's impulsive decisions caused plenty of chaos, usually followed by a glass of bourbon.
But when you love someone, it's everything. Damon fell for Elena and slowly became a better man, although he'll never admit he's a hero.
characters.flaw: You make terrible decisions and call them plans.
characters.signature: A smirk, a glass of bourbon and a very well-timed "Hello, brother."
characters.clashReason: they'd make a sarcastic joke about everything you care about

characters.name: Caroline Forbes
characters.title: The Control Freak With a Heart of Gold
characters.summary: Organised, energetic and fiercely loyal. You plan everything, you care about everyone and you're stronger than anyone expected.
description: Like Caroline, you're the organiser. If there's a dance, a pageant or a town event, she's running it, with a clipboard.
You grew into yourself. Caroline started out insecure and a little bit shallow, and becoming a vampire somehow turned her into the most caring, capable version of herself.
You're a brilliant friend. Caroline and Stefan went from mentor and student to best friends, and eventually more.
characters.flaw: You need to be in control, and you panic when you're not.
characters.signature: A colour-coded binder, a perfect ponytail and a party she planned in three hours.
characters.clashReason: they'd reorganise your whole life without asking

characters.name: Bonnie Bennett
characters.title: The Selfless Witch
characters.summary: Loyal, powerful and always the one paying the price. You'd give anything for your friends, and you often do.
description: Like Bonnie, you're the friend who always comes through. She's a witch from the powerful Bennett line, and her magic saves her friends again and again.
You give more than you get back. Bonnie has lost her powers, her family and even her life to protect the people she loves.
You're stronger than anyone realises. Through all of it, Bonnie keeps getting back up, and she finally learns to fight for her own life too.
characters.flaw: You sacrifice so much for others that there's nothing left for you.
characters.signature: Candles, an old grimoire and a nosebleed from doing too much magic.
characters.clashReason: they'd always be putting themselves at risk for you

characters.name: Katherine Pierce
characters.title: The Survivor
characters.summary: Clever, seductive and ruthless. You always look out for yourself first, and you always survive.
description: Like Katherine, you're a survivor above all else. She spent over 500 years on the run from Klaus, always one step ahead.
You play people. Katherine made both Salvatore brothers fall in love with her, and she's been manipulating everyone around her ever since.
You look after number one. Katherine will switch sides, lie or run the moment it keeps her alive, and she makes no apologies.
characters.flaw: You'll betray anyone to save yourself.
characters.signature: Perfect curls, a knowing smile and an escape route already planned.
characters.clashReason: they'd drop you the moment it suited them

characters.name: Matt Donovan
characters.title: The Human Heart
characters.summary: Steady, loyal and completely normal, in the best way. You work hard, you look after your people and you never give up on your town.
description: Like Matt, you're the down-to-earth one. He's a human in a town full of vampires, witches and werewolves, and he keeps showing up anyway.
You work hard for what you have. Matt worked at the Mystic Grill for years to keep things going at home.
You're devoted to your hometown. Matt went to the police academy and became the town's sheriff, determined to protect it.
characters.flaw: You feel like you're always on the outside of your friends' world.
characters.signature: A Mystic Grill apron, a football jacket and a sheriff's badge.
characters.clashReason: they'd want a quiet, normal life and nothing more

characters.name: Alaric Saltzman
characters.title: The Reluctant Father Figure
characters.summary: Wry, steady and dependable. You're the grown-up in the room, even if you'd rather be having a drink.
description: Like Alaric, you're the reliable one. He started out as a history teacher at Mystic Falls High, with a secret life as a vampire hunter.
You end up looking after everyone. Alaric became a father figure to Elena and her brother, even though nobody asked him to.
You've got a dry sense of humour and a soft spot for bourbon. Alaric's drinking sessions with Damon became one of the show's unlikeliest friendships.
characters.flaw: You carry everyone's problems, then drown them in bourbon.
characters.signature: A history textbook, a crossbow and a drink at the bar with Damon.
characters.clashReason: they'd give you a lecture, then pour you a drink

questions.text: Friends are organising a big event and ask you to help. You...

options.text: Run the whole thing, with a colour-coded binder and three backup plans
Say you're busy, then just turn up for the party
Do the heavy lifting and set out the chairs
Help out, then quietly fix everything that goes wrong

questions.text: Someone asks you to choose between two people you care about. You...

options.text: Agonise over it for a very long time
Why choose? Keep your options open
Step back so they can be happy, even if it hurts
Talk it through with your best friend until 2am

questions.text: A friend does something reckless that puts everyone at risk. You...

options.text: Roll your eyes and help clean it up. You've done worse
Fix it, even if it costs you
Pour two drinks and talk it through
Take the blame so they don't have to

questions.text: An evening completely to yourself. You...

options.text: Write everything that happened today in your diary
Pour a bourbon, light a fire and put on an old record
Read a big history book with your phone off
Plan your whole week while a romcom plays in the background

questions.text: Someone comes after the person you're closest to. You...

options.text: Make them regret it. Painfully
Protect your friend, whatever it costs you
Step in, even though you're outmatched
Depends. What's in it for you?

questions.text: Something you did ends up hurting someone badly. Afterwards you...

options.text: Carry the guilt for years
Pretend you don't care, then secretly try to make it right
Apologise and try to fix it straight away
Move on. Guilt is a waste of time

questions.text: You need a part-time job. You pick...

options.text: Behind the bar at the local grill
Event planning. Obviously
Tutoring. You love sharing what you know
Whatever pays well and lets you leave town fast

questions.text: You're trying to break a bad habit for good. You...

options.text: Set strict rules and stick to them every single day
Quit cold turkey. Starting tomorrow. Probably
Download three apps and track your progress in a spreadsheet
Why bother? Your bad habits are part of your charm

questions.text: Your life gets turned upside down overnight. You...

options.text: Hold it together for your family, then cry in private
Draw up a new plan and throw yourself into it
Put everyone else first and ignore how you feel
Keep working. The bills won't pay themselves

questions.text: Someone offers you a deal that saves you but hurts other people. You...

options.text: Take it. You're a survivor
Refuse. You'd never trade someone else's life for yours
Accept, but only if it protects the one person you love most
Find another way, whatever it costs you

questions.text: You live in a small town secretly full of vampires. You find out the person you're dating is one. You...

options.text: Freak out, then give them a chance to explain
Ask them everything. Immediately
Walk away. You just want a normal life
Start researching how to protect yourself

questions.text: You're a witch. Saving your best friend will cost you your powers, and maybe your life. You...

options.text: Do it. Your friends come first
Absolutely not. You come first
Offer to take the risk yourself instead
Ask for time to research every other option
